lines.en: I hop forward, bounce by bounce.
I bounce faster than I can talk.
I hop after my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我从你前面横着跳过去。
lines.en: I hop across in front of you.
Every two steps, I have to hop.

lines.zh: 我蹦到石头上，又蹦下来。
lines.en: I bounce onto a stone and down again.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，跳得很近。
lines.en: I hop close behind you.
I hop and wave my paws.
I bounce too high and land badly.
I bounce around a tree and on.

lines.zh: 我跳到你边上，撞了你一下。
lines.en: I hop to your side and bump you.

lines.zh: 我蹦着蹦着停下来看天。
lines.en: Mid-hop, I stop to look at the sky.

lines.zh: 我跳的时候耳朵会飞起来。
lines.en: My ears fly up when I hop.
I stop dead, suddenly.
My head tilted, I watch you without moving.
I hop once in place.
I raise a paw, gesturing at something.
I call twice, without words.
I crouch and hold a blade of grass.
I swivel my ears.
I sniff my own paw.
I'm counting ants.

lines.zh: 我想了半天，什么也没想。
lines.en: I think a long time and think nothing.
I plop down on the grass.

lines.zh: 我把肚子挺起来晒太阳。
lines.en: I puff out my belly to the sun.
I burst out laughing.
I grab my tail and spin once.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，我一直看着。
lines.en: I keep staring at what's in your hand.
You! Yes, you!
I hop right up to you.
Why aren't you hopping?
I tug your sleeve.
Your face is funny.
Let's hop together!
I hold up a paw and wait.
I don't understand what you say.
I bounce over to your other side.
When you smile, I bounce up.
I yell at you - did you hear!
I pat your knee.
I point over there: look!
I lean my head on your leg.
Why are you so tall?
I reach out for your fingers.
We can just stand together too.
I drag you that way.
Show me what you've got.
I wave a paw at you.
I roll once and spring right up.
I crouch and hold my head.
I crouch, holding my ears.
I let out one short squeak.
One hop and I'm behind you.
I shudder, fur on end.
I stop laughing, just for a moment.
I touch the sore spot; it's fine.
I can't hop; I'll walk.
I'm still following you.
That! That one!
I bounce up to grab it.
I smell it; so good.
Mine, mine, mine.
I hop a circle around you.
I hold your hand and won't let go.
I'll take a small bite and see.
You're holding it too high!
I sit on your foot and wait.
Is that sweet?
I'm drooling.
Why are you laughing? Hand it over.
I stretch my paw out far.
I've jumped onto you.
I whine, quietly.
I promise not to bite your hand.
Just one bite, honestly.
We collide, and I roll over.
I charge in and roll away first.
I fall and spring right up.
One ear is squashed crooked.
I cling to your leg.

lines.zh: 你脚抬起来，我赶紧跳开。
lines.en: Your foot lifts; I hop clear.
I bounce between your legs.
After the bump I laugh.
I pat the dirt off my backside.
You step back, and off I bounce.
Another is bouncing too.
Her ears are longer than mine.
We bounce along together.
I knock her over.
She shoves me; I shove her.
We sit and laugh together.
She snatches my food.
She rests her head on mine.
We bounce the same height.
Two of us, very loud.
I grab that piece of food.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的捡起来给你。
lines.en: I pick up what you dropped and give it back.
I run off hugging a fruit.
I bounce with a blade of grass in my mouth.
I pick up something shiny.
I throw a pebble at you.
I pick up that stick.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的帽子顶在头上。
lines.en: I put the fallen hat on my head.
I run dragging a cloth.
I pick up the doll and hug it.
That thing!
I see it moving.
I bounce in front of you.
It's too close to you.
I shout at it.
It runs, so I chase!
I stand between.
I point it out to you.
I go first.
It trampled the grass.
I hop after it.
It runs; I bounce faster.
I hop ahead of it.
I swipe at it.
It turns; I bounce away.
I shout at it.
I bounce back in to hit.
Big or not, I'll still charge.
It lowered its head - now I go!
I'm getting tired of hopping.
I headbutt it.
I claw it once.
I bounce up and slam down.
I bite its foot.
I thwack it with the stick.
I startled it.
I butt it with my head!
That one made me fall.
I bounce back in.
It backs off; I chase two hops.
I pop out and startle you!
It's so big here!
First I hop a circle.
I see a person.
I flick my ears at the air.
I run over to look.
I hop twice to warm up.
I yell once, very loud.
I raise my paws.
What shall we do today?
My fur singed; I pat it twice.
I tumble twice.
I swallow water and cough it out.

lines.zh: 我被吹得滚远，又跳回来。
lines.en: I'm blown away and bounce back.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的耳朵，吓我一跳。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ear and startles me.

lines.zh: 有光照着我，我眼睛花了。
lines.en: A light shines on me and dazzles me.
My belly's empty; I can't bounce.
Thunder cracks; I hold my head.
I keep falling and can't see you.
